name: Ask about business travel no-show rules
goal: User inquires about no-show rules for business travel bookings.
constraints: Bot must answer only from KB, personalize reply, and cite correct doc/link. No external info or suggestions.

testdata.query: What are the no-show rules for business travel bookings?

phases.description: User asks about no-show rules for travel.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot responds with Megha Bansal's name/designation, lists no-show rules, and provides correct source and signed URL.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
